_about: The carrier layer of the coaching documents: what Apollo is told about the carrier the agency writes for. coaching_text.py fills coaching/src/*.md with it (staff.json's agency.carrier picks the folder). occupations_methodology.md is METHODOLOGY's occupation-discount list (the groups, as the carrier states them); occupations_training.md the TRAINING deck's opening line.
name: Farmers
_heard_as_regex: how Whisper hears the carrier's name on a call (transcribe.SELF_ID): a regex alternation; Deepgram, which hears it right, uses the name itself
